title: Steve Kroft on Bari Weiss’ “Disastrous” ‘60 Minutes’ Shakeup: “This Is Journalistic Interference, Makes No Business Sense Whatsoever”
summary: In a new interview with PBS News' Geoff Bennett, Kroft was asked his thoughts on Scott Pelley's firing, the dismissal of EP Tanya Simon, and correspondents Cecilia Vega and Sharyn Alfonsi also being let go by CBS News.
